decisions.reason: Positive C, kappa and tau do permit v_h=sqrt(kappa/(C tau))>c, but the Postulate adopts a supported-rest effective subsystem, not unconditional relativistic causality. Its mathematical supplier states v_h<=c iff kappa<=C tau c^2, and the physical theorem and home page explicitly retain that conditional test. Minkowski background geometry alone does not impose this inequality on an independently adopted constitutive subsystem. Imposing it would remove the deliberate parameter-comparison regime rather than repair a false claim.

The forward bounds |theta|<=|A| and |q|<=(C/k)|A|(1/(2 tau)+Omega), combined with an open product neighborhood inside D, allow arbitrarily small nonzero A and ensure T0+theta>0.
